description: Source code for the StubGenerator class, which generates stubbed JAR files from filtered Java classes, primarily used for debugging or testing Android projects.

classes.name: StubGenerator
classes.description: A utility class for generating stubbed JAR files from filtered Java classes, used in Android development.

methods.name: generateStubbedJar
methods.description: Creates a stubbed JAR file from a set of ClassReader objects, filtering out private members.

methods.name: classNameToEntryPath
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified Java class name into a JAR entry path.

methods.name: createJar
methods.description: Writes the classes into a JAR file output stream.

methods.name: visitClassStubber
methods.description: Processes a ClassReader to produce a stubbed class byte array, applying filtering.
